3. Billing

You use the appropriate mass billing transactions in the Billing menu. The SAP system only selects the billing orders with

the MDUS status Request Confirmed Successfully, and processes them as follows:
a. The SAP system analyzes the billing order again using the billing-relevant data.

b. The SAP system checks whether the results of the MDUS request match the billing order, or whether the billing
relevant data has changed.

=» Nochange: The billing order is billed. The individual results of the MDUS request are aggregated again for the

operands.

= Change: The results of the MDUS request cannot be billed because, for example, a price has changed during
the billing period. The billing order is given the status Request Billed with Errors. You must repeat the MDUS

request.

Constraints

You can only perform a billing simulation for profile values in an external system for billing orders for which billing is possible. Other
forms of simulation (such as unbilled revenue reporting or budget billing) are only possible for profile values that have been saved

in the SAP System.

Billing in combination with period-end billing, backbilling, or billing in advance is only possible with restrictions. Operands that
receive values from the MDUS request can only be used in rate steps that belong to the periodic billing period.

Profiles in SAP and MDUS Systems

Use

Profiles exist in the Meter Data Unification and Synchronization system (MDUS system) and in the SAP system, but with the
following distinction:

e MDUS system: Profile header and detailed profile values

e SAP system:Profile header

Settings in the SAP System

Make the following settings to specify that the profile values are not managed in the SAP system:

e Define a role for the profile allocation (for the register) in Customizing as follows:
o Role category Measurement

o Select the Profile Values in External System checkbox.

Path: Customizing for Energy Data Management under |)}Profile Management > Profile Allocation » Define Roles for
Profile Allocation
